account.signIn.title: Kudingeka ukungena ngemvume
account.signIn.message: Sicela ungene ngemvume ukuze ubone okuthunyelwe kwakho, umsebenzi wakho, nephrofayela yakho.
account.posts.errorTitle: Ayikwazanga ukulayisha okuthunyelwe kwakho. Sicela uzame futhi emva kwesikhashana.
account.posts.emptyMessage: Dala isihloko sakho sokuqala esivela ku-studio.
account.activity.emptyMessage: Zama ukuhlola, ukubuyekeza noma ukugcina izihloko emtatsheni wakho.
account.activity.storageHint: Umsebenzi ugcinwa kulesi siphequluli (kanye naku-akhawunti yakho uma ungene ngemvume). Uhlu oluphelele lutholakala ku-{link}.
account.profile.photoDesc: Lesi sithombe sibonakala lapho igama lakho livela khona, njengamazwana namamenyu.
account.profile.deleteDesc: Iphrofayela yakho nolwazi lwakho lokungena ngemvume luzosuswa futhi iseshini yamanje izophela. Okuthunyelwe kwakho namazwana kuzohlala njengokuqukethwe komsebenzisi osusiwe.
account.profile.confirmDelete: Ingabe ufuna ukususa i-akhawunti yakho? Iphrofayela yakho nolwazi lwakho lokungena luyosuswa futhi iseshini yakho izophela.
account.profile.errorSave: Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza iphrofayela. Sicela uzame ukulondoloza futhi emva kwesikhashana.
account.profile.errorDelete: Ayikwazanga ukususa i-akhawunti. Sicela uzame futhi emva kwesikhashana.
account.profile.loadingError: Ayikwazanga ukulayisha iphrofayela. Sicela uzame futhi emva kwesikhashana.
account.page.title: Iphrofayili yami
account.page.subtitle: Hlola okuthunyelwe kwakho, imisebenzi yakho, futhi uphathe imininingwane yephrofayela yakho.
